title: Carousel
description: The baseline carousel of slides: Carousel holds a CarouselViewport of CarouselSlide elements and a CarouselTabList with a CarouselTab dot for each slide, one slide per view. The viewport snaps to each slide, a fast swipe stops at the next one, the Previous slide and Next slide buttons show on every device and dim at the ends, the dots follow the scroll position, and screen readers hear a carousel of slides named by position. The selectedId and setSelectedId props follow the slide that shows, so the buttons take its color. Use it as the starting point for a carousel that shows one item at a time.
